'''Patrick Dinelle''' was a [[Shadow Squadron]] member (Shadow 40) of the [[Players Committee]], listed at Montreal, Quebec on the 23 April 2003 roster.<ref name="vol20030423">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 23 April 2003)</ref> He was the tournament director of the [[2003 Quebec Provincial Championship]] (13 April 2003, University of Quebec, Montreal).<ref name="pc-intl03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> On 18 April 2003 the Players Committee retroactively disqualified him from that event, forfeiting all his prizes, including the title of Champion, the bye into Day 2 of the World Championships and the uncut sheet; [[Raphael Asselin]] was declared 2003 Quebec Provincial Champion.<ref name="pc-quebecruling">[http://swccgpc.com/News/quebecruling04182003.htm Championship Circuit Committee's Official Ruling on Quebec Provincial], swccgpc.com (18 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030612201254/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/quebecruling04182003.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pc-apr03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/Archives/april03archives.htm April Updates], swccgpc.com (18 April 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030810085606/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/april03archives.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
